items.title: Frank Wess — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Miles and I were playing together. He comes by my place and we jam for hours.

ctx.x: Yeah, Lineage Records, yeah. And so, Miles and I were playing together. He comes by my place and we jam for hours. Bass and drums, and we play; I have to play all the time. At my age, if you don’t it goes as quick as it comes so I have to stay active. He comes back quite often and we play for hours. Having had his own record company, you know, he was friends with Hank Jones also, so he’s the one that got us together for that particular recording, “Hank and Frank.”
Can you talk a little bit about with two such statesmen of jazz, and playing in…both of you, while your in your 80’s Hank is in his 90’s if I’m not mistaken.
